creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen 2026-11-09 ~22:40 in a worker's ./dev -tl at load 14: detection::claude_codes_hooks_report_working_blocked_and_idle sat 70 minutes until killed. A hook's sh was waiting in `cat` for stdin (`case "$(cat)"`), the test daemon idle, no deadlock. It passed alone in 8 s. A hook stdin that never closes stalls the whole suite with no timeout; find who holds the write end, and give the test a deadline so it fails instead of hanging.
title: A daemon test hangs for an hour when a Claude Code hook's stdin never closes
